## Shinywidgets gallery episodes

- Portrait episodes can show a floating code card over the live app. Landscape episodes show the same excerpt beside the app at the same cue.
- Gallery episodes get a small opening label, word-by-word captions with an episode accent, and quiet background audio.
- Set custom pronunciations in `pronunciations.yaml`. Narration timing stores those rules for cue lookup and captions. Changes to spoken forms refresh cached takes.
- Editorial validation can flag long static shots and captions that run into the end card.

This release includes both skill variants.
